description: This file implements a SimpleSpanProcessor for OpenTelemetry tracing, which synchronously exports completed spans to a trace exporter. It includes functions for creating the processor, handling span end events, shutdown procedures, and logging.

classes.name: simpleSpanProcessor
classes.description: A span processor that synchronously exports spans to a trace exporter.

methods.name: NewSimpleSpanProcessor
methods.description: Creates a new instance of SimpleSpanProcessor with the provided exporter.

methods.name: OnEnd
methods.description: Exports a span immediately upon completion.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the span processor and its exporter.

methods.name: MarshalLog
methods.description: Returns a loggable representation of the span processor.
